text:
maria_cs: FYI — prepping QBR for BlueLattice. Need a quick sync on spend forecast, onboarding status, and renewal health (renewal in ~32 days). Can we capture action items and any immediate guardrails? :calendar:

josh_se: Onboarding update: core integration live, product team still finalizing API key rotation. Usage profile is embeddings-heavy (~70% of calls). No major errors.

anika_re: Heard from BLIT that they've seen accuracy drift on long-document embed+rerank flows. They asked whether switching model families would help; worried about cost.

sam_finops: Quick billing snapshot:
```
month_to_date_tokens: 12,450,000
avg_cost_per_1k_tokens: $0.0018
mtd_spend: $22.41
proj_90d_tokens: 37,800,000
proj_90d_spend: ~$68,000
```
We've already tripped the budget alert at 15M/mo — alerts-bot pinged them earlier.

alerts-bot: Alert: BlueLattice has exceeded 15,000,000 tokens this billing period. Threshold=15,000,000. Next alert at 18,000,000.

bluelattice_admin: Thanks — we put a draft QBR deck in their share (link below). Can Redwood include a cost breakdown and recommended burst/quota strategy? Also want a short enablement on embedding best practices. https://blue.lattice/qbr-draft

maria_cs: Proposed immediate actions:
1) 1-hr enablement with BLIT product + engineering — owners: @josh_se, @anika_re
2) Apply temporary quota cap to avoid runaway spend (suggest 18M/mo soft cap)
3) Provide model/quantization playbook for embeddings (cost vs quality tradeoffs)
4) Draft renewal health note highlighting spend trend as a potential friction point

josh_se: I can run perf + quality evals on their prompt set. Need 8–12 representative prompts and a link to the QBR deck. Also can apply a temporary quota via infra CLI. Example I'll run:
```
/infra quota set --account=blue_lattice --monthly_tokens=18000000 --reason="QBR temporary cap"
```

anika_re: I'll run model comparison (baseline vs 4-bit quant embeddings) and report expected token cost reductions + any measured recall/precision deltas. Early estimate: 4-bit quant could be ~2.5x cheaper for embeddings but watch for rare-token quality drop.

sam_finops: For the QBR deck I'll produce a three-scenario forecast (conservative/expected/aggressive) with token counts and $ projections. Will also propose adjusted alert thresholds and recommended commitments (if they want predictable pricing). ETA: EOD.

maria_cs: Owner assignments:
- josh_se: evals + enablement demo
- anika_re: model recommendations + quality risk note
- sam_finops: forecast table + budget alert tuning
- maria_cs: QBR narrative, renewal health writeup, and consolidation of action items

maria_cs: Can everyone ack and note blockers? :white_check_mark:

josh_se: Ack — I'll start evals once prompts shared.

anika_re: Ack — will share preliminary numbers in thread.

sam_finops: Ack — prepping forecast table now.

bluelattice_admin: Ack — I'll drop 10 sample prompts in this thread and confirm link permissions. Also open to a 30-min pre-QBR sync later this week.

maria_cs: Great. Quick blocker note: if BLIT wants to try quantized embeddings, we should schedule a canary release on Dedicated or a low-latency fallback policy to Hosted to avoid production regressions.

josh_se: Agreed. Plan: canary on a small subset of requests + automated quality check. I'll add the canary run to the enablement demo.

maria_cs: Thanks all — I'll compile the deck sections after your inputs. Leaving this pinned for QBR prep.
